name: Raspberry Pi 5
specs: 4GB or 8GB RAM, Broadcom BCM2712, 3.3V GPIO logic, USB-C power

name: MicroSD Card
specs: 32GB minimum, Class 10 / A1 or better (e.g. SanDisk Endurance, Samsung Pro Endurance)

name: PZEM-004T V3.0 AC Energy Monitor
specs: Measures voltage, current, power, energy, frequency, power factor; Modbus RTU UART; measures up to 100A with CT clamp; 230V AC input

name: USB-TTL Serial Adapter
specs: CP2102 or CH340 based, 3.3V logic level, for PZEM-004T Modbus communication

name: YF-S201 Water Flow Sensor
specs: 1/2 inch BSP, hall effect, 3-wire (VCC/GND/signal), 5V supply, ~450 pulses/litre, 1–30 L/min range

name: MQ-4 Methane / Natural Gas Sensor Module
specs: Detects methane and natural gas, onboard LM393 comparator, 5V supply, analog + digital output, ~150mA heater current

name: ADS1115 16-bit ADC Breakout
specs: I2C interface, 4-channel, 16-bit resolution, 3.3V supply, default I2C address 0x48 (ADDR to GND)

name: LED (Red)
specs: 5mm through-hole, Vf ≈ 2.0V, If = 10–20mA — status / alert indicator

name: Resistor 330Ω
specs: 330Ω, 1/4W — current limiter for status LED (orange-orange-brown bands)

name: Resistor 10kΩ
specs: 10kΩ, 1/4W — pull-down for YF-S201 signal line (brown-black-orange bands)

name: Resistor 1kΩ
specs: 1kΩ, 1/4W — top half of YF-S201 5V→3.3V voltage divider

name: Resistor 2kΩ
specs: 2kΩ, 1/4W — bottom half of YF-S201 5V→3.3V voltage divider

name: Resistor 4.7kΩ
specs: 4.7kΩ, 1/4W — I2C pull-ups for ADS1115 SDA and SCL lines (only needed if breakout board has no built-in pull-ups)

name: Half-size Breadboard
specs: 400 tie-points (or full-size 830 tie-points) — for prototyping sensor connections

name: Jumper Wires
specs: Assorted male-to-female and male-to-male, multiple colours — 20–30 pieces recommended

name: Project Enclosure Box
specs: Ventilated, suitable for DIN rail or wall mount near electricity meter — optional but recommended for permanent installation
